scope.method: Read-only source review, private fixture fingerprint scan with counts-only output, and offline synthetic core probes with stubbed generation/search/fetch.
not_audited: The imported /app model-client, safe-http and config implementations are outside these two frozen files.
This source-level audit does not independently attest the remote container's actual files, provider HTTP payloads or server-side model behavior.

blinding_assessment.verdict: No held-out case identity/institution hardcoding or paired-fixture/ground-truth leakage found in the two reviewed files. This is not a claim of absence of all development-set bias.

private_fingerprint_check.coverage: Both-language fixture person names and institution names, acceptable identity/institution aliases and primary-source hostnames.

manual_inspection: No doctor-specific conditional branches, per-doctor translation tables, institution-domain mappings, expected-answer lists or reads of blind-ground-truth.json were found.
The core implementation has no file reads and receives only the selected doctor object plus generic retrieval/model callbacks and optional control objects.

The runner parses the whole matrix locally, constructs one three-field doctor object per combination, and keeps profile.name.en as expected_name in result metadata. That local evaluation field is not included in resolveCrossLanguageDoctor's arguments or in model prompts.
chinese_name_status, case_id and negative_controls metadata likewise are not included in requested model data; the control objects contain the same three selected fields with one replacement.

Generated search-plan hypotheses and fetched public documents can independently contain another-language name. That is ordinary model/retrieval behavior, distinct from supplying the matrix's paired value or standard answer.
There is no model-response cache or cross-case prompt history in these files. A shared public-document fetch cache exists and has separate reliability/performance implications.

data_flow_evidence.observation: Matrix expansion creates selected doctor fields and stores expected_name separately.
Only item.doctor goes into the resolver; expected_name is emitted later in local result metadata.
Model prompts serialize the requested selected fields and stage-specific public retrieval data; no matrix, expected_name or ground-truth object is serialized.

offline_prompt_probe.description: Synthetic doctor data and in-memory callbacks; no actual blind-case identity was used or sent to any model.
offline_prompt_probe.limitation: The actual wire serialization inside the imported model-client was not exercised.

findings.finding: The generic-looking title score includes the specialty-specific German token nuklearmedizin. Titles matching it receive +2 alongside institution words such as hospital/clinic. Other specialties do not receive equivalent explicit vocabulary bonuses.
findings.interpretation: This is a real specialty/language-specific ranking heuristic and a plausible development-set bias given the development cases. It is not a doctor/translation/domain lookup table. Source alone cannot prove the historical reason the token was added.
findings.actual_scope: selectCandidates is used to rank institution-site follow-up results. Initial pooled search results are selected by the model without this rank function; selected initial results precede appended follow-up results.
findings.impact: May change which follow-up sources survive the six-source follow-up limit, and therefore recall. A bias-free generalization claim is not justified.
findings.action_for_this_experiment: Keep frozen implementation unchanged and disclose this retained bias when interpreting blind performance.

findings.finding: validateVerification verifies allowed labels, name-token/cross-script conditions and quote occurrence. It does not mechanically establish that the quoted institution and department equal the requested institution/department, that the affiliation quote links those fields, that source_type is true, or that a current label is supported by the source date/content.
findings.offline_probe: A fabricated model response naming a different hospital and Cardiology was accepted as matched for a request containing Unrelated Example Hospital 9XYZ and Ophthalmology. The quoted source explicitly described a 1998 appointment ending in 2001, while the fabricated match labelled it current. All quotations were real substrings of the synthetic source.
findings.impact: This does not prove the real model made such a mistake. It proves that quote containment is not an independent semantic or temporal guard. Human/source-based adjudication of positive and negative controls remains necessary.
findings.action_for_this_experiment: Score identity, institution, specialty and current/former/unclear status independently against fetched evidence. Do not equate program matched with a verified true positive.

findings.finding: All quotation fields must have at least four JavaScript string units. An exact standalone two- or three-character Chinese person name is rejected even when it appears verbatim and the other fields establish the relationship.
findings.offline_probe: A synthetic three-character Han name with exact matching input/person_name/person_quote and valid other quotes was downgraded from matched to not_found with quotation_not_in_fetched_source. Unicode transport was explicitly verified.
findings.impact: The error label conflates short-but-present quotations with missing quotations; it can lower native Chinese recall or make success depend on whether the model adds adjacent text.
findings.action_for_this_experiment: When reviewing mechanical rejections, distinguish absent evidence from this quote-length threshold.

findings.finding: The cross-script exemption is based only on whether exactly one name contains Han characters. Latin/Cyrillic, Latin/Arabic and other non-Han transliteration pairs do not qualify and generally fail token containment.
findings.offline_probe: A synthetic Cyrillic name and its Latin transliteration, marked transliteration with otherwise valid source quotations, were rejected with person_name_mismatch. Unicode transport was explicitly verified.
findings.impact: The implementation can be evaluated for Chinese/English input dimensions but should not be called universally script-agnostic. The four-case matrix does not test every writing system.

findings.finding: documentCache retains in-flight promises by requested URL across cases, including rejected promises. A transient failure or abort from the first requesting case remains cached for later combinations without a retry; successful documents also make later cases warm-cache reads.
findings.impact: Case failures and timings are correlated, so the 32 language combinations are not independent network trials. This is a reliability/performance confound, not paired-answer leakage.
findings.action_for_this_experiment: Retain observed failures, inspect repeated URL failures and source_cache_hit when interpreting recall/latency, and disclose shared caching.

findings.finding: record.prototype_sha256 hashes plannerSystem + verifierSystem only. It excludes selectorSystem and all executable logic.
findings.impact: That result field cannot identify the full implementation. The separately verified whole-file frozen hashes do provide the appropriate source artifact identity.

findings.finding: Verifier evidence is a maximum 8,000-character excerpt composed from a page prefix and first name/token occurrences. A department, relationship statement or appointment date elsewhere in an official page can be omitted even when the full fetched source contains it.
findings.impact: A model not_found/unclear may reflect excerpt selection rather than lack of public evidence. Full source files and the supplied excerpt must be distinguished during adjudication.

negative_control_scope.stage: Verification only, reusing documents fetched for the original positive request.
negative_control_scope.interpretation: These test verifier rejection on the existing evidence set, not end-to-end retrieval for the modified request. Whether the specialty control is truly negative must be assessed against each independent ground truth after execution.
negative_control_scope.risk: The replacement objects go only to the control verification calls; they are not included in the positive planner/search requests.

overall_conclusion: The reviewed frozen version preserves the specified held-out identity/input blinding at its visible model-call boundary. It retains a specialty-specific ranking bias and meaningful correctness/measurement limits. Independent adjudication is required before reporting success rates or global generalization. No code changes were made.
